label: Minimum tabs required to show the sort button
description: Type how many ungrouped tabs are needed before the sort button appears. Lower this below 6 to sort with fewer tabs (e.g. 2 or 3). When tab groups already exist, the button still shows with just 1 ungrouped tab.

label: Keep ungrouped tabs above groups
description: Tabs that are not in a group go above the groups instead of below them, in every space: at startup, when you turn this on, and after each sort. Tabs you drag by hand are left where you put them.

label: Close duplicate tabs when tidying
description: When you press the broom, tabs open more than once in this space are closed, keeping one. Reopen with Cmd+Shift+T.

label: Automatically sort new tabs into existing groups
description: When a new tab finishes loading, the local AI moves it into the group in its space that clearly fits best. Tabs you drag out are never moved again.

label: Create a new group when no group fits
description: Off: tabs that match no group stay ungrouped. On: the AI makes a new named group for them.

label: Use a local LLM (Ollama) for sorting and naming
description: Sends tab titles and addresses (no query strings) to Ollama on this computer. Usually more accurate than the built-in AI. If Ollama is not running, the built-in AI is used.

label: Ollama address
description: Tab titles and addresses are sent to this address. Keep it on localhost unless you trust that machine.

label: Ollama model
description: Name of the Ollama model to use. It must already be pulled.

label: Always put these sites in these groups
description: One rule per line or separated by ';'. Left: part of the address. Right: group name. Rules win over the AI.

label: Automatically assign Advanced Tab Groups icons after sorting
description: Runs in the background after sorting finishes (no extra sort time). Skips groups that already have an icon, so manual picks are never overwritten. Turn off if you prefer plain groups.

label: Use fast keyword shortcuts for icons
description: Off by default: the local AI embedding match runs over the full Tabler set. Turn on to let common topics match instantly first (e.g. shopping goes straight to the cart icon).

label: Suggest better workspaces after sorting
description: After sorting, show a persistent sidebar card for tabs that look like they belong in another workspace (based on workspace name + pinned tabs). Click a row to move it, X to dismiss. Never auto-moves.

label: Match workspaces by name only
description: On: embed only the workspace name (stricter, fewer suggestions). Off: embed workspace name plus pinned tab titles (more context, more suggestions).
